# CBDB-Desktop: Places form revisions, 2026-10-15

Found while writing the Places (Look At Place) section of the user's guide, not from an automated-testing report, so this entry has no CBDB-D number yet. Assign one as needed. PLC-1 to PLC-5 are in the 2026-10-14 report. Changes are in Code/places_form_backend.go and the form's index.html. They were compiled and tested.

## Summary

| Ref | Issue | Fix | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| PLC-6 | The "Export as ASCII (pinyin) instead of Unicode" option, a remnant from before Unicode was widely supported, was still on the form and in the back end | Checkbox, translations, helper and request field removed from the front end; Encoding fields and every ASCII branch removed from the back end. Exports are always Unicode | Compiled, tested |

## PLC-6: ASCII export option removed

**Background.** The steering committee agreed that the ASCII (pinyin-only) export option is no longer needed. Before this change, the checkbox (chk-ascii) set encoding: 'ascii' on the GIS/KML, Neo4j, UCINet, Pajek and Gephi export requests (CBDB-D-011 had made the checkbox reachable).

**Removed from index.html.**

- The chk-ascii checkbox and its lblAscii label in the Actions panel.
- The exportAscii translation in English, Traditional and Simplified. setLanguage never set the label, so it needed no change.
- getExportEncoding() and its CBDB-D-011 comment.
- encoding from the request body of exportGIS, exportNeo4j, exportUCINet, exportPajek and exportGephi.

**Removed from places_form_backend.go.**

- The Encoding field from PlaceExportParams, PlaceNetworkExportParams and PlaceNeo4jExportParams. The GIS and KML writers never read it.
- handleExportNeo4j: the ascii / encStr variables. buildPlaceNeo4jFiles no longer takes ascii and encStr parameters.
- buildPlaceNeo4jFiles: in all six CSV files, only the Unicode header and row remain. The People file always uses the Chinese dynasty name (still "unknown" when blank); the IndexAddrCode file always includes the Chinese description (still "Missing" when blank). The "VBA header (ascii)" comments were removed.
- handleExportUCINet, handleExportPajek, handleExportGephi: the encoding preamble. In Pajek, vertex and edge labels use the Chinese name or relation and fall back to pinyin only when the Chinese is blank. In Gephi, the label is the Chinese relation and edge_desc the English description.

**Also fixed.** The comment header above handleExportNeo4j was missing; its text had run into the end of the placeWriteResultsPeopleTab comment. The header was restored and its file list updated to the actual file names.

**Not changed.**

- Output file names keep the _UTF8 suffix (PlacesNeo4j_UTF8.zip, People_UTF8.csv and the other Neo4j CSVs, network_UTF8.vna, network_UTF8.net, network_UTF8.gdf), so existing Neo4j import scripts and documentation still match. The suffix is now redundant and may be dropped later.
- The UCINet, Pajek and Gephi export functions and routes are kept, although the form has no buttons for them. The Places query does not build social or kinship networks, so these exports would produce fragmentary networks; the code is kept in case the steering committee later wants the buttons added.
- Go's JSON decoder ignores unknown fields, so a cached page that still sends encoding causes no error.

**For the user's guide.** All Places exports are Unicode (UTF-8). There is no ASCII option.
